lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular spots is visible posterior to the gill region, organized into approximately 7 horizontal rows and multiple vertical columns across the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are observable, intersecting with the circular blobs to form a grid-like pattern, most prominent in the central and posterior sections of the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with high-intensity luminance on the dorsal edge and a corresponding shadow immediately ventral.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent irregularly shaped high-luminance patch is visible on the upper anterior flank, indicative of a surface abrasion or lesion. Smaller, less-defined depigmented marks are also visible along the dorsal-lateral ridge.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a dense cluster of high-luminance spots that are significantly smaller and more concentrated than those found on the primary lateral flank.
